objective: Maximize macro-average patient event F2 proxy on seizure-bearing inner-validation patients. Event precision proxy = detected seizure events / (detected seizure events + false-alarm episodes).
limitations: False-alarm episodes are reported as counts; false alarms/hour is unavailable because exact recording durations are absent.
The event F2 proxy is an exploratory threshold-selection objective, not a clinical false-alarm-rate metric.
Only the first LOPO fold is evaluated; the result is not a 23-patient estimate.
Threshold selection uses only the three seizure-bearing inner-validation patients in this fold.

candidate_generation.method: score quantiles from 0.95 through 1.00, plus existing validation F1/F2 thresholds
